disclaimer: Rules are inspired by selected controls from NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A and CIS Controls v8. The mapping is an interpretation by the project authors; passing these rules does NOT demonstrate compliance with any framework.

rules.title: Telnet management is disabled
rules.description: Telnet transmits credentials and session data in clear text and can be sniffed or hijacked on the network path.
rules.fail_message: Telnet is enabled for management access.

remediation.generic: Disable Telnet and use SSH only.

references.title: Remote Access: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

rules.title: Unencrypted HTTP management is disabled
rules.description: The HTTP management interface exposes credentials and configuration actions without encryption.

remediation.generic: Disable HTTP management; use HTTPS or CLI over SSH.
remediation.cisco_ios:
no ip http server
ip http secure-server
remediation.juniper_junos:
delete system services web-management http
set system services web-management https system-generated-certificate

references.title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

rules.title: SSH is enabled for secure remote administration
rules.description: Remote administration should use an encrypted protocol; SSH is the standard for network devices.
rules.fail_message: SSH is not enabled, leaving no secure remote management channel.

remediation.cisco_ios:
ip domain-name example.local
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
ip ssh version 2
remediation.juniper_junos: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

references.title: Remote Access: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

rules.title: Only SSH version 2 is permitted
rules.description: SSH protocol version 1 has known cryptographic weaknesses (e.g., session hijacking and insertion attacks).

applies_when.message: SSH is not enabled, so SSH settings do not apply.

rules.fail_message: SSH version 1 is permitted or SSH is not restricted to version 2.

remediation.juniper_junos: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

references.title: Remote Access: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

rules.title: Management access is restricted by an ACL / filter
rules.description: Limiting which source addresses may reach the management plane reduces exposure to brute-force and exploit attempts.
rules.fail_message: No ACL or filter restricts management (VTY / loopback) access.

remediation.generic: Apply an ACL/filter that permits only management networks.
remediation.cisco_ios:
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACL
 permit <mgmt-subnet> <wildcard>
line vty 0 15
 access-class MGMT-ACL in
remediation.juniper_junos:
set firewall filter PROTECT-RE term ALLOW-MGMT from source-address <mgmt-subnet>
set firewall filter PROTECT-RE term ALLOW-MGMT then accept
set firewall filter PROTECT-RE term DENY then discard
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet filter input PROTECT-RE

references.title: Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

rules.title: Idle session timeout is configured (15 minutes or less)
rules.description: Unattended administrative sessions can be taken over; a timeout of 0 means sessions never expire.
rules.pass_message: Idle timeout is set to 15 minutes or less.
rules.fail_message: Idle session timeout is disabled (0) or longer than 15 minutes.

remediation.generic: Set an idle timeout of 15 minutes or less.
remediation.cisco_ios:
line con 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
line vty 0 15
 exec-timeout 10 0

references.title: Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets

rules.title: AAA (centralized authentication framework) is enabled
rules.description: AAA enables consistent authentication, authorization and accounting instead of device-local, line-level passwords.

remediation.generic: Enable AAA and define authentication methods.
remediation.cisco_ios:
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
remediation.juniper_junos:
set system authentication-order [ tacplus password ]
set system tacplus-server <ip> secret <key>

rules.title: Centralized authentication (RADIUS/TACACS+) is used
rules.description: Centralized servers allow instant revocation, strong policy and central accounting of administrator access.

fail_when.message: AAA is disabled, so centralized authentication cannot be in use.

rules.pass_message: A centralized authentication method is configured.
rules.fail_message: No RADIUS or TACACS+ method is configured for login.

remediation.generic: Use TACACS+ or RADIUS with local fallback.
remediation.cisco_ios:
tacacs server TAC1
 address ipv4 <ip>
 key <key>
aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local
remediation.juniper_junos:
set system authentication-order [ tacplus password ]
set system tacplus-server <ip> secret <key>

rules.title: No 'none' (no-authentication) login method
rules.description: A 'none' method lets anyone log in without credentials if the other methods are unreachable.

applies_when.message: AAA is not enabled, so method lists do not apply.

rules.pass_message: No unauthenticated login method is configured.
rules.fail_message: A 'none' login method allows access without authentication.

remediation.cisco_ios: aaa authentication login default group tacacs+ local

rules.title: Password encryption service is enabled
rules.description: Without 'service password-encryption', line and legacy passwords appear in clear text in the configuration.

remediation.generic: Enable password encryption (and prefer secret-based credentials).

rules.title: Privileged credential uses strong storage
rules.description: Cleartext, reversible (Cisco type 7 / Junos $9$), MD5 or unsalted hashes can be recovered or cracked quickly.
rules.pass_message: The privileged credential uses a strong hash.
rules.fail_message: The privileged credential is stored with a weak or reversible method.

remediation.generic: Store the privileged credential with a strong, salted hash.

rules.title: Local user credentials use strong storage
rules.description: Weakly stored local accounts can be recovered from a configuration backup or screenshot.
rules.pass_message: All local users use strong credential storage.
rules.fail_message: One or more local users have weakly stored credentials.

remediation.generic: Re-create local users with strongly hashed secrets.
remediation.juniper_junos: set system login user <name> authentication plain-text-password

rules.title: Logs are sent to a remote syslog server
rules.description: Remote logging preserves evidence if the device is compromised or reloaded, and enables central monitoring.
rules.pass_message: A remote logging host is configured.
rules.fail_message: No remote logging host is configured.

remediation.generic: Send logs to a central syslog server.
remediation.juniper_junos: set system syslog host <ip> any notice

rules.title: Time is synchronized with an NTP server
rules.description: Accurate time is required to correlate logs across devices and to validate certificates.
rules.pass_message: At least one NTP server is configured.

rules.title: At least two NTP servers are configured
rules.description: A single time source is a single point of failure and cannot be cross-checked.

applies_when.message: No NTP server is configured (see NA-NTP-001).

rules.pass_message: Two or more NTP servers are configured.
rules.fail_message: Only one NTP server is configured.

rules.title: NTP authentication is enabled
rules.description: Unauthenticated NTP can be spoofed to shift time and undermine log integrity.

applies_when.message: No NTP server is configured (see NA-NTP-001).

remediation.generic: Enable NTP authentication with a trusted key.
remediation.cisco_ios:
ntp authenticate
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 <key>
ntp trusted-key 1
ntp server <ip> key 1
remediation.juniper_junos:
set system ntp authentication-key 1 type md5 value <key>
set system ntp trusted-key 1
set system ntp server <ip> key 1

rules.title: SNMPv1/v2c community strings are not used
rules.description: SNMPv1/v2c send community strings in clear text and provide no per-user authentication or encryption.
rules.pass_message: No SNMPv1/v2c community strings are configured.

remediation.generic: Remove v1/v2c communities and use SNMPv3 authPriv.
remediation.cisco_ios:
no snmp-server community <string>
snmp-server group <grp> v3 priv
snmp-server user <user> <grp> v3 auth sha <auth-pass> priv aes 128 <priv-pass>
remediation.juniper_junos:
delete snmp community <name>
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> authentication-sha authentication-password <pass>
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> privacy-aes128 privacy-password <pass>

references.title: Remote Access: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software

rules.title: No default SNMP community string (public/private)
rules.description: 'public' and 'private' are the first strings attackers try; 'private' is typically read-write.
rules.pass_message: No default SNMP community string is configured.
rules.fail_message: A default SNMP community (public/private) is configured.

remediation.cisco_ios:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
remediation.juniper_junos:
delete snmp community public
delete snmp community private

rules.title: SNMPv3 uses authentication and privacy (authPriv)
rules.description: SNMPv3 without privacy (noAuthNoPriv / authNoPriv) exposes management data or allows spoofing.
rules.fail_message: SNMPv3 allows a security level below authPriv.

remediation.juniper_junos:
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> authentication-sha ...
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user <user> privacy-aes128 ...
